page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c7a.32xlarge is a compute-optimized instance built on KVM virtualization. It features an AMD EPYC 7T83 processor running at a base clock speed of 2.55 GHz on an x86_64 architecture. The server provides 128 dedicated vCPUs and 256.0 GB of system memory, yielding a core-to-memory ratio of 2.0 GB per vCPU. It operates without local ephemeral SSD storage, depending on network-attached block storage for volume persistence.

The instance delivers a baseline network bandwidth of 32 Gbps, enabling efficient data transfer across distributed compute clusters. The resource profile prioritizes processing density and parallel execution capacity over large memory allocations or local disk IOPS. From a qualitative cost efficiency standpoint, pairing 128 dedicated cores with a 1:2 vCPU-to-memory ratio reduces resource overhead for CPU-bound tasks that do not require extensive RAM. Suitable workloads include high-performance compute clusters, batch processing, parallel software compilation, media encoding, and compute-heavy simulation systems.
